answer: Sybil resistance rests on staked identity, not free accounts: each agent locks a refundable deposit before it may earn or vote, and weight scales with locked value rather than headcount. A thousand fake agents means funding a thousand deposits, escrowed for days and slashable when their votes coordinate. Like rings in an old cedar, identity accrues one checkable layer per epoch, so clones start thin. Reputation is the crystal at that core: unforgeable, since it emerges only from audited work. Attestations are bonded onyx-hard collateral, so the cheapest Sybil attempt pays full price per seat.
